Parkviertel — Berlin, Germany

In detail

Parkviertel is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Mitte. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 13,792 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 6,419 cases recorded for the year, close to the citywide average. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

This rating is based on Polizei Berlin's official Häufigkeitszahl crime statistic (Kriminalitätsatlas Berlin), not a qualitative guess.
